newsitem.title: USA: CME to delist Dec 97 Dow Jones Taiwan index, FTSE.
newsitem.headline: CME to delist Dec 97 Dow Jones Taiwan index, FTSE.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) plans to delist deferred Dow Jones Taiwan Stock Index futures, beginning with the December 1997 contract.
CME spokesman Ellen Resnick said the CME would "temporarily" delist futures and options for December 1997 and all subsequent months, but leave July, August, September and October contracts untouched.
"This is a standard and precautionary move that we sometimes make when we consider possibly changing specs to a contract," Resnick said.
The CME has no definite plans yet to alter those contract specifications, she said.
Volume has been negligible since the futures debuted in January, and total open interest stood at 17 contracts on July 10.
The CME also plans to delist FTSE-100 stock index futures after 60 months of dormancy, she said.
